name: Google Cloud Storage
line: Store, secure, and deliver files in regional and multi-region buckets.

free.text: 5 GB-mo; 5K A, 50K B ops; 100 GB NA egress; 7d deleted hold; no idle pause

cells.regions: Choose a region, dual-region, or multi-region bucket

sql.math: Cloud Storage stores objects, not SQL databases
Cloud Storage stores objects, not SQL databases

files.math: 100 GB is 93.1323 GiB (one GiB is 2³⁰ bytes). Storage: 93.1323 × 730 × $0.000027397. Requests: 100 × $0.005, plus 1,000 × $0.0004. Outbound data: 93.1323 × $0.12. These add up to about $13.94. There is no free tier.

jobs.math: Cloud Storage stores files and does not run background jobs
